import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static class ModInt2 {
        long x;
        ModInt2() { x = 0; }
        ModInt2(int sig) {
            long sigt = sig % MOD;
            if (sigt < 0) sigt += MOD;
            x = sigt;
        }
        ModInt2(long sig) {
            long sigt = sig % MOD;
            if (sigt < 0) sigt += MOD;
            x = sigt;
        }
        int get() { return (int)x; }
        ModInt2 add(ModInt2 that) {
            long res = this.x + that.x;
            if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
            return new ModInt2(res);
        }
        ModInt2 subtract(ModInt2 that) {
            long res = this.x - that.x;
            if (res < 0) res += MOD;
            return new ModInt2(res);
        }
        ModInt2 multiply(ModInt2 that) {
            long res = (this.x * that.x) % MOD;
            return new ModInt2(res);
        }
        ModInt2 addInPlace(ModInt2 that) {
            this.x += that.x;
            if (this.x >= MOD) this.x -= MOD;
            return this;
        }
        ModInt2 subtractInPlace(ModInt2 that) {
            this.x -= that.x;
            if (this.x < 0) this.x += MOD;
            return this;
        }
        ModInt2 multiplyInPlace(ModInt2 that) {
            this.x = (this.x * that.x) % MOD;
            return this;
        }
    }

    static class Matrix {
        ModInt2[][] v;
        Matrix(int n, int m) {
            v = new ModInt2[n][m];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++)
                    v[i][j] = new ModInt2(0);
        }
        int height() { return v.length; }
        int width() { return v[0].length; }
        ModInt2 at(int i, int j) { return v[i][j]; }
        void set(int i, int j, ModInt2 val) { v[i][j] = val; }

        static Matrix identity(int n) {
            Matrix A = new Matrix(n, n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                A.set(i, i, new ModInt2(1));
            return A;
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix B) {
            int n = height(), m = B.width(), p = B.height();
            // assert(p == width());
            Matrix C = new Matrix(n, m);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    ModInt2 sum = new ModInt2(0);
                    for (int k = 0; k < p; k++) {
                        sum = sum.add(this.at(i, k).multiply(B.at(k, j)));
                    }
                    C.set(i, j, sum);
                }
            }
            return C;
        }

        Matrix multiplyInPlace(Matrix B) {
            Matrix C = this.multiply(B);
            this.v = C.v;
            return this;
        }

        static Matrix pow(Matrix A, long k) {
            Matrix result = identity(A.height());
            Matrix base = A;
            while (k > 0) {
                if ((k & 1) == 1) {
                    result = result.multiply(base);
                }
                base = base.multiply(base);
                k >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }
    }

    static Matrix getRotateMatrix(int k, int t) {
        t = (t % k + k) % k;
        Matrix A = new Matrix(k + 3, k + 3);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            A.set(i, (i + t) % k, new ModInt2(1));
        }
        A.set(k, k, new ModInt2(1));
        A.set(k+1, k+1, new ModInt2(1));
        A.set(k+2, k+2, new ModInt2(1));
        return A;
    }

    static Matrix getSingletonMatrix(int k, int j) {
        // assert(0 <= j && j < k);
        Matrix A = new Matrix(k + 3, k + 3);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            if (i != j) {
                A.set(i, i, A.at(i, i).add(new ModInt2(1)));
            }
        }
        A.set(k+1, k+1, new ModInt2(1));
        A.set(k+2, k+2, new ModInt2(1));

        A.set(k, k+1, A.at(k, k+1).add(new ModInt2(1)));
        A.set(j, k+1, A.at(j, k+1).subtract(new ModInt2(1)));

        A.set(k, k, A.at(k, k).add(new ModInt2(2)));
        A.set(j, k, A.at(j, k).subtract(new ModInt2(1)));

        A.set(k, j, A.at(k, j).add(new ModInt2(1)));
        return A;
    }

    static int s_k(int k, long j) {
        long t = j;
        int u = 0;
        while (t > 0) {
            u = (u + (int)(t % k)) % k;
            t /= k;
        }
        return u;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        while (sc.hasNextLong()) {
            long n = sc.nextLong();
            int k = sc.nextInt();

            Matrix b = new Matrix(1, k + 3);
            b.set(0, k, new ModInt2(1));
            b.set(0, k+1, new ModInt2(1));
            b.set(0, k+2, new ModInt2(1));

            long powk = 1;
            int digits = 0;
            while (powk <= n / k) {
                powk *= k;
                digits++;
            }

            List<Matrix> P = new ArrayList<>(digits + 1);
            P.add(getSingletonMatrix(k, 0));
            for (int i = 1; i <= digits; i++) {
                Matrix cur = Matrix.identity(k + 3);
                for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                    cur = cur.multiply(P.get(i-1));
                    cur = cur.multiply(getRotateMatrix(k, -1));
                }
                P.add(cur);
            }

            long offset = 0;
            while (powk > 0) {
                int t = (int)((n - offset) / powk);
                for (int j = 0; j < t; j++) {
                    int s = s_k(k, offset);
                    b = b.multiply(getRotateMatrix(k, -s));
                    b = b.multiply(P.get(digits));
                    b = b.multiply(getRotateMatrix(k, +s));
                    offset += powk;
                }
                powk /= k;
                digits--;
            }

            ModInt2 ans = b.at(0, k+1);
            System.out.println(ans.get());
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
